game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits. Each round, winter bandits strike the frozen well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the frozen well from winter bandits in Firewood Stacks: keep the spells meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: spells drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while spells > 0.
